plain_language_research_question: How might professionalization be examined alongside institutionalization when occupational formation and durable institutional embedding are not assumed to have one historical direction?
How might gendering be examined alongside commodification when the available composition evidence comes from only one source and the market and gender regimes must remain explicit?
How might imitation be examined alongside piracy when legal, market, normative, and historical regimes determine whether the concepts remain distinct?
How might canonization be investigated through bounded questions about selection and exclusion without inventing a second semantic concept?
How might self-exoticization be investigated as a bounded reflexive research question while keeping agency, audience, external gaze, and power asymmetry explicit?
